analysis_type: New retrospective analysis of retained predictions; no model training or inference

taxonomy.statistic: pooled binary macro-F1 difference; fixed two-class label set
taxonomy.scores: five-source-fold probability ensembles as saved; taxonomy_global_prob_neoplastic versus prob_neoplastic

operating.statistic: pooled outer-test specificity DCTG minus Joint
operating.scores: raw saved positive-class probabilities, decimal CSV values read as float64
operating.threshold_rule: Per model and outer fold: highest observed positive validation score with validation sensitivity >=0.90; score>=threshold; ceil(9*n_positive/10) positives required. All thresholds frozen before opening test outcome metrics.

inference.null: paired model predictions exchangeable within each retained group, conditional on labels and fitted models
inference.permutation_unit: entire recorded group; fixed group membership, no images moved between folds/groups
inference.method_selection: Based on input group structure only, before p-values. If each group has one image, compute exact binomial-weighted randomization over discordant outcomes within each true class. Otherwise enumerate all swaps if <=20 groups have statistic-relevant differences; else use 1,000,000 independent group swaps. Inactive groups integrate out exactly.
inference.exact_p: extreme assignment probability under independent fair group swaps; no Monte Carlo plus-one adjustment
inference.multiplicity: Holm within the prespecified six taxonomy contrasts and separately within the two specificity contrasts
inference.confidence_intervals: No new confidence intervals in this p-value-only analysis; Monte Carlo SE is numerical sampling error, not model uncertainty

limitations: Retrospective analysis after previous outcome inspection; not prospectively prespecified confirmatory evidence.
CystoDS recorded patient groups; EBTC filename-derived cases; Kaggle one image per group, not verified patient units.
Conditional on saved models and chosen validation thresholds; excludes training and threshold-selection uncertainty.
External cloud code, seed and exact test algorithm unavailable; previously quoted p values are not target values.
